name: Bertrand competition
summary: Economic pricing game where firms simultaneously set prices for identical goods to capture demand and maximize profit.
rules_text: There are n firms with identical constant marginal cost c and no capacity limit. Market demand D(p) is decreasing. Each firm simultaneously chooses a price p_i >=0. Consumers observe all prices and buy only from the lowest-price firms. If one firm has the unique lowest price p, it serves entire demand D(p) and earns (p-c)*D(p). If k firms tie for lowest price p, they split demand equally, each earning (p-c)*D(p)/k. Firms with higher prices earn zero. Payoffs are profits and each firm aims to maximize its own profit.
